title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Terms: Number of Agreements, Space Availability and One Vehicle per Space
content:
**Clause 1 — Holdings per customer.** A customer may hold Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreements for up to 4 spaces at once. Agreements count toward that limit while they stand reserved, active, delinquent, under a notice of intent to tow, under a compliance termination notice, or moving out. Each agreement covers exactly one vehicle and one space.

**Clause 2 — Open problems first.** A customer who already holds a delinquent, tow-noticed or termination-noticed parking agreement must resolve it before a new space is reserved. In business terms, an agreement standing delinquent, under a notice of intent to tow, or under a compliance termination notice is an open problem; agreements that stand reserved, active, moving out, vacated, towed or with a cancelled reservation do not stand in the way of a new reservation. The standing is read from the customer's agreement records, not from the customer's account of them.

**Clause 3 — Availability.** A parking space is reserved only when the facility inventory shows it as available, for that specific space.

**Clause 4 — No sharing.** Parking spaces are never shared between two agreements, and a vehicle already on file under another agreement is not reserved again.

### Points of judgement

| Situation shown by the records | Bearing on a new reservation |
|---|---|
| The customer already holds 4 agreements in the counted standings | The limit of 4 is reached |
| The customer holds 3 agreements in the counted standings | Within the limit |
| One of the customer's agreements stands delinquent, under a notice of intent to tow, or under a compliance termination notice | That agreement must be resolved before a new space is reserved |
| The facility inventory does not show the space as available | The space is not reserved |
| The vehicle named is already on file under another agreement | That vehicle is not reserved again |

Hypothetical count: a customer with two active agreements, one moving out and one vacated holds three agreements toward the limit of 4 — the vacated agreement does not count.
